preprocessing: Original PNG RGBA white-composited RGB, then Pillow L; output same-size grayscale PNG.
gate: Actual product PP48 tensor, unchanged v4.1 gate. False keeps verified B583 baseline, no restoration inference.

thresholds.method: Exact global three-nonempty-class multi-Otsu maximizing sum(s_i*s_i/w_i).
thresholds.search: Nonzero gray bins only; NumPy float64 vectorized scores; collect score>=max-16*eps*N*255^2, then exact Python integer rational cross-comparison.
thresholds.class_intervals: low gray<=t1; middle t1<gray<=t2; high gray>t2
thresholds.ties: Earliest (t1,t2) lexicographic; every mode and remaining-peak tie chooses smallest gray via argmax.

validation.background: a2 equals the global earliest-gray argmax mode.
validation.remaining_peak: After removing gray values a0 and a2, earliest global highest-frequency gray must lie in middle.
validation.near_gray: Original RGB max-min<=16; no extra blackness threshold.
validation.low_coverage: Exact gray==a0 among near-gray pixels appears in >=90% of all original columns, including edges.
validation.middle_coverage: Exact gray==a1 among near-gray pixels must appear in <90% of original columns.
validation.failure: Abstain to unchanged cached baseline; no other thresholds, morphology, guessed lengths or interpolation.

recovery.recognizer: The same fixed B583 through actual captcha.solve once per restored image; no new training weights.

required_reports: fixed dev exact/CER and ordinary changes
no newly empty results or exceptions
next_stage: Report fixed single-pass train/dev. If gate passes, freeze sole chain and require root decision plus new blind and real ABBA speed verification.
